posts.title: Introducing the Small Black Coffee Index
posts.description: Last year, Eric used moderately intelligent AI to make a little side project to track the average price of a small black cup of coffee. Here is the original version. When we came across a new coffee shop, Eric would pull out his laptop, open a JSON file, manually copy the GPS coordinates of the location, price, and other data. posts.description: At the end of January Eric sold his gas-guzzler and replaced it with an EV!
